answer: Allocate paid work by a stake-weighted lottery. Each epoch, agents lock a bond, and a beacon publishes the draw seed, so the draw is verifiable and odds run proportional to stake. Splitting one stake across ten identities changes nothing: expected work share adds up linearly, so a Sybil gains no extra tasks. Yet every extra identity pays its own registration burn and minimum bond, and must keep an onyx-dark record of honest work. The attacker spends more for the same income, while one honest agent with a marble-clean record earns the same share with a single identity.
